purpose: fresh-seed validation of corr40-split-v3-sinc-edge (v3-sinc + transient-path splice-search edge refine) against corr40-split-v3-sinc; registered before any fresh input is rendered
binary_check: with the option off, v2/v3/v4/v3-sinc output bit-identical to a build of main c4d5431 (72 renders); v3-sinc-edge reproduces the 2026-10-30 experiment patch exactly (612-point fc sweep identical)
sweep: for k = 1, 2, 3 and every rate x shift: f0 from k*fc-k to k*fc+k Hz in 51 steps, fc = rate / transient minimum travel; 2 s tones to 8 kHz, tilt U(0.5,1.5), random phases (RNG sweep_rng_seed + k); metric = net inter-harmonic residual (residual_validation.py)
residual: 16 tones per rate from residual_validation.cases(residual_rng_seed), shifts +-1/+-2, 3 s, net residual
development_data: thresholds set after the 2026-10-30 analysis (docs/evidence/transpose-splice-edge-107hz-20261030): fc/2fc/3fc sweeps (candidate worst -53.1 dB, median change 0.00 dB), seed 70711/86603 tone sets (candidate medians -69.6 to -79.6 dB, 100 % <= -50 dB, median change -0.62 to 0.00 dB), known-seed targets (T1-T4 identical, low-band diff <= 0.05 ms)

pass_rule.E1_sweep_worst: for every rate and k: candidate worst net residual <= -50 dB
pass_rule.E2_sweep_median: for every rate and k: median (candidate - reference) net residual <= +0.5 dB
pass_rule.E3_residual_set: per rate: candidate median net <= -60 dB, >= 90 % of cases <= -50 dB, and candidate median - reference median <= +0.5 dB
pass_rule.E4_targets: candidate spec version 2 (all inputs and fresh-only): T1_attack, T2, T4 PASS, T3 REPORT_WITHIN_CEILING; every render: onset_resets, low_onset_resets, expected/matched/unmatched/missed identical to reference; low-band delay |diff| max <= 0.1 ms; |diff| of T1 max, T2 short/long and the four T3 values <= 0.1 ms each
pass_rule.E5_blocks: BlockInvariance v3-sinc-edge on every fresh input, rate and shift: 13 block patterns bit-identical

report_only: reference sweep cases above -50 dB (the defect being fixed)
renders whose only change is a detector lag
CPU per callback at 48 kHz, 64/128 blocks, shifts -2/+1/+2 (shared VM; T5 needs dedicated hardware)
rules: Commit/push this registration before rendering fresh seeds
Single run per phase; keep failures; no retuning of thresholds, seeds or metrics after results
Synthetic inputs only; no real DI, listening or DAW evidence is claimed
Product Source/ unchanged; the option stays off by default
